title: FeSBCP Analogue from Cyanobacteria: Insights from in vitro and in silico Studies
authors: Boral A; De T; Banerjee A; Biswas T; Chakraborty B; Mitra D
one_liner_zh: 该文通过体外实验与计算建模研究蓝藻FeSBCP蛋白与含6-4光损伤DNA的结合与修复，虽属蛋白质-DNA互作且含对接建模，但对象非典型TF-DNA体系，方法以生物信息学与对接为主，深度有限。
abstract: The blue light responsive Cryptochrome/Photolyase Family harbours two important photoactivatable proteins - cryptochromes and photolyases. While cryptochromes are essentially photoreceptors with diverse biological activities including circadian rhythm, photolyases repair UV damaged cyclobutane pyrimidine dimers (CPD) or (6-4) pyrimidine-pyrimidone photoadducts. Both cryptochromes and photolyases share a common Photolyase Homology Region (PHR) where they harbour a light harvesting antenna chromophore and redox-active flavin di-nucleotide (FAD). Even though photolyases do not possess an extension in the C-terminal region unlike cryptochromes, a recent discovery of FeS cluster containing bacterial cryptochrome-photolyase proteins (FeSBCPs) present an interesting retreat from the conventional photolyase architecture. They possess an additional modular redox center, [4Fe4S] iron-sulfur cluster connected by conserved cysteine residues. Herein, we characterize a cyanobacterial FeSBCP from Cyanobium sp . using tools from bioinformatics, biochemistry and biophysics. Sequence analysis reveals substitution in the well-conserved aromatic residues, meant for electron transfer. In silico modeling and docking supported by electrophoretic mobility shift assay as well as spectroscopic measurements do suggest efficient binding and repair of CyPhrB to damaged single/double-stranded substrates containing 6-4 photolesion. Considering FeS clusters’ established roles in DNA binding/repair activities, we speculate the role of FeS clusters in FeSBCPs and existence of FeS-FAD-DNA triangle towards efficient electron transfer.
abstract_zh: 蓝光响应的隐花色素/光裂合酶家族（Cryptochrome/Photolyase Family）包含两种重要的光激活蛋白——隐花色素（cryptochromes）和光裂合酶（photolyases）。隐花色素本质上是具有多种生物活性的光受体，包括昼夜节律调控，而光裂合酶则修复紫外线损伤的环丁烷嘧啶二聚体（CPD）或（6-4）嘧啶-嘧啶酮光加合物。隐花色素和光裂合酶共享一个共同的光裂合酶同源区域（PHR），在该区域中它们携带一个光捕获天线发色团和一个氧化还原活性的黄素二核苷酸（FAD）。尽管与隐花色素不同，光裂合酶在C末端区域没有延伸结构，但最近发现的含FeS簇的细菌隐花色素-光裂合酶蛋白（FeSBCPs）对传统光裂合酶架构提出了有趣的偏离。它们拥有一个额外的模块化氧化还原中心，即由保守半胱氨酸残基连接的[4Fe4S]铁硫簇。在此，我们利用生物信息学、生物化学和生物物理学工具，对来自Cyanobium sp.的蓝藻FeSBCP进行了表征。序列分析揭示了在高度保守的芳香族残基中发生替换，这些残基原本用于电子传递。通过电泳迁移率变动分析和光谱测量支持的计算建模与对接实验，确实表明CyPhrB能有效结合并修复含有6-4光损伤的单链/双链底物。考虑到FeS簇在DNA结合/修复活性中的既定作用，我们推测FeS簇在FeSBCPs中的功能，以及FeS-FAD-DNA三角结构在高效电子传递中的存在。
